name: Yamaha GTS1000
engine: 1002 cc liquid-cooled inline four, fuel injected, hub-center steering
intro: Yamaha's odd sport tourer with a swingarm front end instead of forks. Rare, with unique steering parts.

L: The front end is a swingarm with a hub-center steering linkage. Check every pivot for play before you ride it.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
